obligations.requirement: Routed Ink enters one common Brush session and emits renderer-neutral preview/commit contracts.
acceptance: BrushInputBatch or equivalent common input exists
BrushPreviewDelta exists without Skia/GPU/platform types
BrushCommitIntent exists and is confirmed-only
Brush Engine does not mutate SemanticDocument directly

obligations.requirement: Incremental Vector preview reconstructs the accepted one-shot reference result.
acceptance: for frozen Vector fixtures, applying preview deltas reconstructs the same current outline/geometry as one-shot evaluation
counts/order remain exact where the one-shot oracle requires exactness
numeric coordinate error stays within R1 outline tolerance 1e-5
final sealed result matches one-shot reference
known reference limitations remain reference limitations rather than silent fixes

obligations.requirement: Hot-path append work does not scale with total historical stroke length.
acceptance: one-shot full-history evaluator call count during move-time incremental append is zero
work counters expose new-sample and replaceable-tail work
for deterministic repeated local geometry, max per-append evaluated work at 2048 samples is <= 1.25x the max at 512 samples for the same batch size
512 and 2048 sample workloads complete without unbounded preview backlog

obligations.requirement: Confirmed and predicted state are separated with deterministic replacement.
acceptance: predicted samples affect preview only
new confirmed input replaces overlapping predicted tail
predicted data never appears in BrushCommitIntent
session revision is monotonic
stable prefix cannot be mutated by a later non-overlapping append

obligations.requirement: Same-session execution is ordered through BrushPreviewDeltaReady without mandatory inter-module thread hops.
acceptance: sample N+1 cannot overtake N
one logical BrushSession mutation is active at a time
C1 to C0 to C2 path can execute synchronously/directly without a required queue
Arc/GPU completion is not awaited by Brush append
canonical runtime work is not on move-time preview path

obligations.requirement: Preview handoff is bounded/latest-wins for superseded non-terminal revisions while terminal semantics remain reliable.
acceptance: mailbox capacity is finite and inspectable
100 queued non-terminal revisions without consumption do not grow storage beyond capacity
newest valid revision is retained
superseded non-terminal revisions may be skipped
cancel terminal and retire control events are not lost or silently coalesced

obligations.requirement: Canonical commit handoff is reliable and independent of preview presentation.
acceptance: BrushCommitIntent is emitted only from confirmed state on seal
commit intents are never latest-wins/coalesced
commit failure/backpressure is explicit
unrelated canonical congestion does not block move-time preview append
cancel before seal emits no commit intent

obligations.requirement: Preview retirement is driven by matching CanonicalVisible identity, not pen-up.
acceptance: pen-up/seal leaves final preview logically live
stale or mismatched receipt cannot retire the preview
matching session revision generation receipt retires exactly the intended preview
canonical failure cannot masquerade as retirement success

obligations.requirement: Platform-local Brush ownership and raw-pointer preview geometry are removed.
acceptance: Web platform bridge does not own BrushRuntime or Brush session algorithm state
Android platform bridge does not own BrushRuntime or Brush session algorithm state
Windows does not derive Arc preview geometry from raw pointer samples after routing
pointer-level arc_input_fanout_adapter is removed or explicitly non-authoritative and unused by the C2 path
common composition owns Brush begin append seal cancel

obligations.requirement: Accepted C0/C1/R1 behavior remains valid and C2 stays inside scope.
acceptance: C0 interaction regressions PASS
C1 ingress/ownership regressions PASS
R1 perfect-freehand reference regression PASS
git diff --check PASS
production diff contains only authorized C2 paths
exact result/evidence revision is pushed and reviewer-resolvable

oracle_precondition.expected_failure: Pre-C2 BrushRuntime re-evaluates full session history on append; Web/Android own BrushRuntime sessions; Windows derives preview geometry from raw pointer samples; common BrushPreviewDelta and BrushCommitIntent contracts do not yet satisfy C2.
oracle_precondition.observation_seam: C2 incremental/ownership/thread-model tests and source/static ownership checks
